input.summary: Shoot the top from the left flipper and the full-depth vari-target from the right. Build 20,000 base bonus and at least 3X. Then shoot the right saucer to collect the bonus. At 5X, each full collect scores 100,000.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: At 20,000 base bonus, this lit saucer scores base bonus times Bonus X, resets base bonus, and keeps Bonus X this ball.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: A full vari-target hit, a complete six-bank, certain lane-and-target sets, or an outlane advances the multiplier to a maximum of 5X.

quickInfo.name: Lit drop target
quickInfo.summary: A matching top lane lights its target to score 5,000 instead of 500.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball rules
quickInfo.summary: With A and D lit together, either completing A-B-C-D or knocking down all six drops lights Extra Ball, and both objectives light Special.

quickInfo.name: Five-ball rules
quickInfo.summary: With A and D separate, all six drops lights Extra Ball, and A-B-C-D plus all six drops lights Special.

steps.text: On the first ball, read the offset flippers and watch one complete exit from the top bumper area.
From the left flipper, shoot the ball to the top lanes and build base bonus.
From the right flipper, make a full-depth vari-target hit for 5,000 and one Bonus X advance.
modeNotes: Bonus X: The multiplier reaches 5X. Both base bonus and Bonus X reset at the next ball.

steps.text: Repeat the safer top or vari-target shot until base bonus reaches 20,000 and Bonus X reaches at least 3X.
If one required drop remains and its multiplier color is lit, finish that target from the safer glancing angle, then return to the top and vari-target route.
Shoot the right saucer to collect the current bonus.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The saucer scores base bonus times Bonus X. It resets base bonus and keeps Bonus X for the rest of this ball.

steps.text: At 5X, rebuild base bonus to 20,000 and repeat the saucer for another 100,000.

fallback.title: Recovery: Top-only bonus route
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the vari-target rebound is unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot up top from either flipper.
Use lanes and random top activity to build base bonus.
Let complete B or C target-and-lane sets advance Bonus X.
Collect at the right saucer when 20,000 base and at least 3X are ready.

alternatives.title: Position play: Right-gate escape
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when the ball is trapped in right-bumper activity.

steps.text: Nudge the ball toward the right gate.
Take the 5,000 gate value and watch the safer right-arc return.
Cradle on the right flipper when the feed permits it.
Make full-depth vari-target hits or complete the six-bank until Bonus X reaches 5X.
Shoot the top lanes until base bonus reaches 20,000.
Shoot the right saucer for 100,000.
Keep 5X, rebuild the 20,000 base, and collect again.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: When the ball stays near the right bumper, nudge it through the gate for the safer right-arc return.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Nudge as the ball leaves the top through a target gap so it does not continue toward the center drain.

cautions.issue: The right flipper sits higher than the left flipper.
cautions.response: Calibrate both hold points before you use the same timing on each side.

cautions.issue: The rubber below the vari-target can change its return angle.
cautions.response: Watch one full rebound and stop repeating the shot if it reaches a slingshot or center drain.

cautions.issue: Balls can exit the top through the gaps between the B and C targets.
cautions.response: Nudge during the exit to keep the ball away from the center drain.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm three-ball or five-ball rules and award conversions.
Test vari-target depth, right saucer, gates, and offset flippers.
